title: Locating trombonist Roy Palmer
summary: Burton asks for Roy Palmer's new address and the interviewer supplies it.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was going to ask you, well, I think I would sort of interrupt, but about Roy Palmer. We stopped and said hello to him yesterday. I interviewed him a couple years ago.
Yeah, yeah. I hadn't seen him for a number of years.
Did you ever make records with Roy? Do you remember? Roy Palmer is a trombone player. Yes, trombone.
Yes, he just had to move. He was over on Wells Street, and they're putting in a new road down there at 51st and Wells. Yeah. And so he moved down to 68th and Perry.

You put that down from me, baby, because I want to get in touch with him. I'll check the number to make sure that's right. Well, I haven't seen him in so many years, and I often wondered if he was still living so many, the old time has passed away. And what an experience we had in recording.
6816 Perry. The apartment is C. There's several entrances. It's one of the big court buildings, you know, where there's several entrances. So it's the C entrance, 6816. He just moved there Wednesday.
Tore his house down Wednesday. I think he moved.
